subject: Draft MAP: commitment timeline, owners, and procurement signoff checklist
messages:
From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP: commitment timeline, owners, and procurement signoff checklist

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. As promised I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures milestones we discussed, suggested owners on our side, and the procurement/contract deadlines we need to hit to make your June pilot window work. Key items inside:

- Target commercial close: 2027-06-30 (this is the date we can make the pilot live with production keys)
- Procurement signature deadline (internal CW target): 2027-06-15 — we flagged this in the doc as the gating item for provisioning
- Security evidence needed: SOC 2 attestation + data retention policy by 2027-06-01

Please review the attached MAP (ClearWave_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) and the draft SOW. Two asks for you as next step: 1) confirm the procurement signoff date above or propose an alternative, and 2) confirm who the program owner is at ClearWave so we can align milestones and owners.

I cc'd Laura (solutions) and Priyom (contracts) to pick up owner/action items on our side once you confirm. If you'd rather we move the commercial close date to late July to buy extra procurement runway, flag that and we'll adjust the milestone dates.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments:
- ClearWave_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (MAP draft, milestones & owners)
- SOW_draft_20270428.pdf (scope + commercial terms)
From: alicia.gomez@clearwavehealth.com
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.redding@clearwavehealth.com, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: commitment timeline, owners, and procurement signoff checklist

Marcus —

Thanks for putting this together. Quick responses from our side:

- Procurement is targeting a signature deadline of 2027-06-20 based on our Q2 board cycle; we could try to accelerate to 2027-06-15 but that will require a fast internal legal review and a PO to be issued the week prior.
- Security: our InfoSec team requires SOC 2 Type II report and confirmation of the proposed data retention policy. They have a standing review that takes ~10 business days once materials are submitted.
- Program owner: I will be the executive sponsor; Tom (cc'd) will be the technical owner and will coordinate InfoSec.

Two clarifying questions on the MAP: 1) who at Redwood will own the provisioning milestone once signature is complete? and 2) is the pilot acceptance criteria documented in the SOW or should we add a separate acceptance checklist?

I attached CW's procurement intake form (see inline) and I'll drop our legal intake link if needed.

Onboard next steps: if we aim for commercial close 2027-06-30 with procurement signature 2027-06-20, that gives us a short window to complete the InfoSec review. Can you confirm Redwood can meet that runway?

Thanks,
Alicia
Director of Strategic Partnerships | ClearWave Health
alicia.gomez@clearwavehealth.com

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: commitment timeline, owners, and procurement signoff checklist

Alicia — appreciate the clear answers. Short replies and updates: 

- Provisioning owner: Laura Bennett will own provisioning and go-live coordination from Redwood once contracts are signed. I've marked that in the MAP (row: Provisioning -> owner: laura_bennett).
- Acceptance criteria: good call — let's add a short acceptance checklist to the SOW and also include it as a MAP milestone (Pre-Prod acceptance tests: pass basic throughput + sample prompt eval). I'll add bullet acceptance criteria to SOW_v2.
- Runway: we can support the proposed procurement signature of 2027-06-20. To meet the InfoSec review timeline we need your SOC 2 request in the next 3 business days (I can share the evidence pack and a short how-to for your InfoSec reviewer).

I've uploaded an updated MAP with the provisioning owner and shifted a couple milestone dates to reflect a 2027-06-20 signature target: https://docs.redwood.ai/drive/CW/MAP_v0.3 (link in metadata). Also attached a suggested email template that Priyom can use with your procurement/legal team to accelerate PO issuance.

I'll plan to bump our SOW to v0.4 with acceptance checklist and share by Monday. Priyom — can you review the commercial terms and start a brief redline pass so we can circulate?

Thanks — Marcus

Attachments referenced:
- SOW_v0.4 (WIP) — will be pushed Monday
- quick_procurement_email_template.txt

Marcus / Laura / Priyom —

Confirming ClearWave will target procurement signature by 2027-06-20. A couple of notes from legal/procurement after a quick sync:

- Legal will submit redlines; they prefer to receive a marked copy rather than a clean PDF. I've attached our redlines stub (CW_redlines_v1.docx) — that will arrive formally by EOD Wed if not sooner.
- Procurement needs the SOW and a final pricing worksheet to attach to the PO. Can Redwood provide a final pricing worksheet by 2027-05-10?
- Exec intro: I'm happy to do a 15-min intro between our CFO and your Head of Revenue next week; that will help unblock any pricing/discount questions.

If we keep 2027-06-20 for signature, commercial close on 2027-06-30 remains feasible but tight; please confirm the provisioning lead time on your side (Laura).

Thanks,
Alicia
